subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: Which durable TLS identity policy should the iOS app use for manually configured public-CA Remote Domain endpoints that can present multiple valid leaf certificates?
rationale: Source proves the current single-leaf model cannot represent the reported endpoint, but choosing CA trust, a bounded pin set, or continued leaf pinning changes the gateway identity and upgrade contract and cannot be selected safely by automation.

options.title: Split trust by endpoint type
options.body: Use system CA/hostname trust for public-PKI manual domains and preserve explicit fingerprint trust for discovered, direct, or self-signed gateways, with a persisted-state migration.

options.title: Persist a bounded pin set
options.body: Keep certificate pinning but store and manage multiple explicitly trusted leaves per endpoint, accepting added rotation, expiry, and eviction complexity.

options.title: Keep strict single-leaf pins
options.body: Document Cloudflare anycast endpoints as unsupported and improve the UI so users receive a durable explanation rather than a repeated trust loop.

recommendation.title: Split trust by endpoint type
recommendation.body: Use system CA/hostname trust for public-PKI manual domains and preserve explicit fingerprint trust for discovered, direct, or self-signed gateways, with a persisted-state migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history shows the broadest ownership of the iOS gateway connection, pairing, TLS-requirement, and security paths affected by this decision.
